title: Statistics of U.S. Businesses 2022: firms, employment, payroll, receipts by 6-digit NAICS and enterprise receipts size
claim: Firm counts by receipts band, concentration (share of receipts in $100M+ enterprises) and payroll/receipts ratios for obscure 6-digit NAICS; analyst-derived fragmentation screen (firms with $1.0M-$15.0M receipts).
